method: Manual full-resolution anatomical review and native1x comparison. Filename ordinal is not the source of leg identity.
near_leg_definition: Left hip nearest viewer in right-facing three-quarter view; repaired exposed thigh crosses foreground.
far_leg_definition: Right hip farther from viewer; initial contact emerges from right robe hem.

phases.support: Far/right leg reaches heel contact; near/left boot trails on toe.
phases.observation: Wide step, right-hem boot forward with raised toe; left-hem boot trails. Hip origin partly occluded by robe.

phases.support: Far/right boot flat and weight bearing; near/left knee flexed with boot lifted behind.
phases.observation: Supporting boot lies directly below right hem; opposite boot visibly airborne at left. Repair made specifically against far-leading contact.

phases.support: Far/right leg supports toe-off while near/left thigh crosses in front and near boot swings airborne.
phases.observation: Exposed crossing near thigh and raised knee; leading near boot is above ground, trailing far toe supports.

phases.support: Near/left leg reaches heel contact; far/right boot trails behind.
phases.observation: Open robe exposes left-hip-to-right-foreground-thigh path; near heel descends, opposite boot recedes.

phases.support: Near/left boot flat and weight bearing; far/right knee flexed with dark boot lifted behind.
phases.observation: Foreground crossing thigh connects to planted near boot; other boot visibly hangs behind, unlike far-support phase1.

phases.support: Near/left leg supports while far/right boot swings forward airborne toward next far contact.
phases.observation: Earlier independently painted pose reassigned by observed support, not original prompt ordinal. Raised boot emerges from far/right hem; opposite boot planted.

anatomical_confidence: Crossing thigh and lifted support alternatives are now visible; hip occlusion in phases0/5 remains an observation limitation.
preserved_rejections: Earlier six-key gait and v2/v3 alternatives remain in masters with exact prompts.
